verdict.rationale: First-party docs say CLAUDE.md is a markdown file added to the project root that Claude Code reads at the start of every session, used to set coding standards, architecture decisions, preferred libraries and review checklists. A community user confirms relying on CLAUDE.md guide rails in practice, though they report needing ever more of them. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of file scoping or hierarchy beyond the project root, and independent evidence that the agent reliably follows the conventions.
